# TPC-Havoc Q8_v5

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH america_region AS (SELECT r_regionkey FROM region WHERE r_name = 'AMERICA'), america_nations AS (SELECT n_nationkey, n_name FROM nation, america_region WHERE n_regionkey = r_regionkey), qualified_customers AS (SELECT c_custkey, c_nationkey FROM customer, america_nations WHERE c_nationkey = n_nationkey), qualified_orders AS (SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderdate FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('1996-12-31' AS DATE)), qualified_parts AS (SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'), qualified_lineitems AS (SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem, qualified_parts WHERE l_partkey = p_partkey), market_data AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM qo.o_orderdate) AS o_year, ql.l_extendedprice * (1 - ql.l_discount) AS volume, n.n_name AS nation FROM qualified_lineitems AS ql JOIN qualified_orders AS qo ON ql.l_orderkey = qo.o_orderkey JOIN qualified_customers AS qc ON qo.o_custkey = qc.c_custkey JOIN supplier AS s ON ql.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation AS n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) SELECT o_year, SUM(CASE WHEN nation = 'BRAZIL' THEN volume ELSE 0 END) / SUM(volume) AS mkt_share FROM market_data GROUP BY o_year ORDER BY o_year
```
